noveltyJustification: All 4 new: the promised guardians belong to other subsystems (deep-loop, skill-advisor, sk-code); the real mirror invocation is the doctor route with 5 --check lines and 5 trigger phrases; ops/ README self-declares both healers as stubs; and no workflow anywhere runs this package vitest/typecheck/check — the advisor shares its 4 vitest runs, not this repo.
keyQuestions: Are the codex/, pi/, runtime-mirrors/ sync scripts and the evals/ check gate actually invoked, and by what?

label: Two parallel mirror-drift guardians with disjoint coverage: CI runs the deep-loop checker over .opencode|claude|codex/agents only (agent-mirror-sync.yml:15-24, fail-closed) while the doctor route (commands/doctor/_routes.yaml:169-182, 5 trigger phrases) runs --check on ALL FIVE surfaces via 7 sync scripts (doctor-runtime-mirrors.yaml:34-40,141) plus 2 more doctor checkers and install-codex-hooks --check — prompts/pi/claude drift is CI-invisible and neither guardian references the other; codex/generate-command-routers.cjs is the one sync script with no --check line (execution: caller-not-verified). Recommendation: merge into one CI-wired full-coverage guardian.

ops/ is a dispatcher for two self-declared stubs: ops/README.md:15-37 (neither heal-*.sh completes a detect/repair/verify cycle; heal-session-ambiguity exits via a deprecation notice, heal-telemetry-drift always reports its verifier removed and exits with error; both wait on a replacement); runbook.sh (147L) still dispatches to both; the ONLY production-wired ops module is process-sweep.ts (251L, via plugins/session-cleanup.js); process-memory-harness.ts (589L) is test-pinned. Recommendation: merge (collapse runbook+heals+registrations) or fix (finish the promised remediation paths).

The package test, typecheck and 7-script check gate have ZERO CI: of 12 workflows exactly 5 touch system-spec-kit (changed-packet-validation=validate.sh, strict-pass-freshness=repair-derived>backfill, command-tree-parity, markdown-link-integrity=check-markdown-links.cjs, routing-registry-drift — whose 4 vitest runs execute in system-skill-advisor/mcp-server:83-192, not this package); no workflow runs this package vitest (53k-LOC tests/), typecheck, npm test, or package.json:24 check. Recommendation: fix — wire test+check (or a cheap subset) into one workflow, else the tests/ tree is documentation.

setup/ residuals: check-prerequisites.sh = 6 command YAMLs (strong); record-node-version.js = wired via the PARENT package (system-spec-kit/package.json); check-native-modules.sh + rebuild-native-modules.sh = documented-only (.env.example + feature-catalog playbook + 1 changelog, nothing invokes); _utils.sh = uncited-by-content (no sourcing mention anywhere; indirect-variable sourcing: caller-not-fully-verified). Recommendation: document the native-module manual covenant; _utils.sh is a removal candidate.
